messages:
sasha: Heads-up: SDK v4.0 is shipping today at 18:00 PT. Primary change: "strict_output" behavior will be introduced as the recommended default for new projects. :loudspeaker:

sasha: Why: strict_output enforces structured outputs for chat/generation endpoints which reduces downstream parsing errors for customers and improves eval stability. It is optional for now but recommended.

evan: Is this a breaking change for existing apps?

sasha: Evan: No immediate break. Existing projects keep their current setting for 90 days. After that we'll switch new projects to stricter defaults; existing projects will get a prompt in-console and an opt-in migration flow.

zoe: Docs note: I've started a guide with migration patterns and example transforms (loose->strict). Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/strict-output-migration - feedback welcome.

sasha: Migration checklist highlights:
- Run the strict-output linter on your test prompts
- Pin model versions if you rely on prior behavior
- Add a lightweight response-fallback in clients (example in guide)

jules: CLI admin toggle available? want to flip orgs for some beta customers.

sasha: Yes. Admin CLI snippet to set default for new projects:
```bash
redwood admin defaults set --org=my-org --sdk.strict_output=true
```

mike: How are we telling customers about the 90-day window?

sasha: We'll do an in-console banner, two emails (60d/14d), and a changelog post. Growth will handle targeted outreach for flagged enterprise orgs.

docbot: docs/changeset created: /changes/2026-03-23-strict-output.md  preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/changes/2026-03-23-strict-output

release-bot: release/sdk v4.0 deployed to canary region at 2026-03-23T18:00:05Z  status: success :white_check_mark:

zoe: Also added a small compatibility test suite under sdk/tests/compat/strict that CI will run for opt-in customers. Please review the test vectors.

sasha: Action items: 1) Eng: add monitoring metric for "fallback_rate" when strict_output is enabled. 2) Docs: finalize migration code samples. 3) Support: prepare FAQ. I've created tickets and assigned owners.

ejan: tiny nit: can we include a sample for embeddings pipeline? some customers use generate+embed flow.

sasha: Good call - Zoe will add that.

jules: thx all. I'll coordinate enterprise comms and post the timeline in the customer registry.

sasha: Thanks everyone. If you hit anything odd during rollout, please post in #eng-runtime or ping me directly. END THREAD
